title: Peruvian Citrus Beef Stir Fry
description: A gluten-free and flavorful stir fry recipe that combines the bold flavors of Peruvian cuisine with the brightness of citrus.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the mixed bell peppers and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the beef and cook for 5-6 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Stir in the Peruvian chili powder and citrus juice. Cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately over rice or with your choice of sides.
